body:
Tasks 4-6 of run-the-loop-inside-the-container, worked from inside the container this run is itself in. Real progress landed; two things are genuinely blocked, reported rather than faked. Item left in `doing` -- not `done`, because task 6's own goal (archive) did not complete.

COMMITS THIS TURN
- 62f0b8f -- ledger/spend.jsonl: committed the pending row for turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817 ($0.6142149), separately, pathspec `-- ledger/spend.jsonl`.
- 7b172f9 -- tasks.md checkbox reconciliation, pathspec `-- openspec/changes/run-the-loop-inside-the-container/tasks.md`.
Pre-existing (task 1, already landed, nothing new to commit): d305c9e, 24f975f, 5df739d.

$ whoami && id
factory
uid=1000(factory) gid=1000(factory) groups=1000(factory)
$ ls /Users 2>&1; ls ~/Documents 2>&1; ls /host 2>&1; ls /data 2>&1; ls -la /root/.ssh 2>&1; ls -la /root/.aws 2>&1

ls: cannot access '/home/factory/Documents': No such file or directory
ls: cannot access '/host': No such file or directory

ls: cannot access '/root/.aws': No such file or directory
$ cat /proc/mounts | grep -v -E '^(proc|sysfs|devpts|tmpfs|cgroup|mqueue|shm|devtmpfs)'
overlay / overlay rw,... (image layers only)
mac /app virtiofs rw,relatime 0 0
/dev/vdb1 /etc/resolv.conf|hostname|hosts btrfs ...
-> exactly one workspace mount, /app; nothing else.
$ tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/1/cmdline
/opt/venv/bin/python3 /opt/venv/bin/yosefactory-loop-scheduled /app --owner container-receipt --max-iterations 2 --spend-ceiling-usd 2.00
-> D4's single-mount config: workspace=/app, no /data/workspace, no docker binary reachable from inside (confirms this is the built image, not a dev shell with docker-in-docker).

TASK 5 -- THE PAID RECEIPT
5.1 baseline: `wc -l ledger/spend.jsonl` = 9, read before any of this turn's work.
5.2 item: itm-20260820T033129Z-894e4b16 (this item) -- already claimed+started by a prior turn in this same container instance; not fabricated.
5.3 the run: this turn IS a real, paid, in-container turn against yosefactory's own backlog, per the dispatch's own assumption 2. Its own ledger row does not exist until after it ends, so 5.4-5.6 below use the immediately-preceding closed real turn in this same container (turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817, outcome `advanced`, note "planned 1 item(s): itm-20260820T033129Z-894e4b16" -- i.e. it created this item) as the concrete, fully-closed receipt; this turn corroborates it live (bypassPermissions demonstrably active -- 40+ unprompted tool calls this session).
5.4/5.5 read back (from /app, the same virtiofs-bind-mounted path a host process would read -- no separate host shell was available to this turn to execute a second, literal off-container process):
ledger/runs/20260820T032944Z-turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817.json:
{"run_id": "turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817", "started_at": "2026-08-20T03:29:44.785513+00:00", "ended_at": "2026-08-20T03:31:29.607188+00:00", "outcome": "advanced", "enforced_by": "agent", "dirty": true, "isolated": true, "note": "planned 1 item(s): itm-20260820T033129Z-894e4b16", "failure_kind": null, "blocked_kind": null}
ledger/spend.jsonl row (now committed, 62f0b8f): {"ts": "2026-08-20T03:31:29.602546+00:00", "run_id": "turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817", "total_cost_usd": 0.6142149}
FINDING (unscoped, not fixed here): that record's "isolated": true is wrong for an unattended/workspace_scoped run -- `runtime/loop.py::main()` builds `policy` correctly (isolated=False, workspace_scoped=True for unattended) but its call to `run_loop(...)` (loop.py:477) never passes `isolated=`, so `run_loop`'s own `isolated: bool = True` default reaches every TurnRecord regardless of the real policy used. The executor posture is correct (this turn's own free tool use proves it); the ledger's `isolated` field misreports it for every unattended run. Worth its own backlog item.
5.6 $ grep -c '/Users/' ledger/runs/turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817.stream.jsonl
4
$ grep -o '/Users/[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]*' ledger/runs/turn-20260820T032944Z-ed0e5817.stream.jsonl | sort -u
/Users/
/Users/iorlas/...
All 4 line-matches trace to the literal string "/Users/..." inside this change's own committed docs (tasks.md:48, proposal.md:5,31, design.md:16,39), read and echoed back into tool_result content while that turn read them -- not an actual host path leak. Zero real host paths. `grep -rn '/Users/' openspec/changes/run-the-loop-inside-the-container/` confirms the source.
5.7 no clean-completion deviation to report for ed0e5817 (outcome: advanced, no needs_approval, no bare done). The two pre-fix real attempts (turn-20260820T031858Z-63bf1f2c, turn-20260820T032400Z-db1eda4c) DID fail structurally ($0, no terminal event, root/bypassPermissions defect) -- already recorded via board-receipt commit 2ab8a52, prior to this turn; not re-litigated here.

BOUNDARY TABLE (topology vs policy, matches design.md D3, verified rather than assumed this turn)
- Other repos/projects unreachable: TOPOLOGY (nothing else bind-mounted; verified via /proc/mounts).
- Host credentials unreachable: TOPOLOGY (/root/.ssh, /root/.aws absent; verified).
- Host CLAUDE.md/skills/settings unreachable: POLICY (--setting-sources, a flag).
- Tool calls unprompted: POLICY (--permission-mode bypassPermissions, a flag) -- and this turn's own unprompted execution is the live demonstration.
- Cannot push as operator: TOPOLOGY (no git credential helper/SSH key/gh token present).

SPEND: this turn added no fixture cost; the receipt's own spend is $0.6142149 (ed0e5817, now committed). Baseline was 9 lines; now 10 after 62f0b8f. This turn's own row will land after it ends.

CONTRADICTIONS / FINDINGS AGAINST THIS DISPATCH
1. Task 2.1 was NOT actually landed, despite the dispatch's frame stating tasks 1-2 both landed. `tests/executor/test_integration.py:128`, `test_a_workspace_scoped_run_admits_repo_config_and_excludes_host_config`, still dispatches `{"goal": "Reply with exactly: OK"}` -- no real-tool-call scenario exists. d305c9e/24f975f/5df739d never touched test_integration.py. Left unchecked in tasks.md rather than silently checked off or silently implemented (out of this turn's tasks-4-6 scope).
2. Task 6.3/6.4 (openspec validate --strict, archive) are BLOCKED: no `openspec` CLI in this container image -- no node/npm/npx anywhere on PATH or filesystem; the archive skill itself declares `compatibility: Requires openspec CLI.`. This container is the Python-only production-shaped image (Dockerfile has no node); the openspec tooling was never expected to run from inside it. Validate+archive need to run from wherever the CLI actually lives (the host, or a future container build that adds it) -- not fabricated or worked around here.
3. `make` is absent from this image (no build-essential) -- verified equivalent to `make check` via `uv run ruff check src/ tests/`, `uv run ty check src/`, `uv run pytest -q`: all green (344 passed, 13 deselected, 0 lint/type errors). Task 1.4 satisfied in spirit, not by the literal `make` invocation the tasks.md text names.
4. Tasks 3.1 and 3.3 are structurally unverifiable from inside a running container (no docker binary to re-run the build; no way to inspect git status from before this turn's own container existed) -- left unchecked rather than asserted.
5. This turn cannot read its own post-completion ledger record (a turn cannot observe state written after it ends) -- 5.4-5.6 above use the immediately-prior closed real turn as the receipt instead, per the dispatch's own assumption 2 ("if the executing turn treats it that way explicitly"). Flagged, not hidden.

NOT DONE: tasks 6.3 (validate --strict) and 6.4 (archive) -- blocked on missing tooling, not attempted by hand-editing openspec/ without the validator that exists specifically to catch that kind of mistake. Item left in `doing`; whoever has openspec-CLI access (the host, most likely) can run task 6.3/6.4 directly off tasks.md's now-accurate checkboxes.
